overview.summary: Let an annotated ledger run as it is and keep every run label within the summary sheet's 24 characters.

stories.name: Comment lines in the ledger
stories.scope: The ledger reader skips a line that starts with a hash, so an annotated ledger yields the records of the ledger without its notes.

stories.name: Short run labels
stories.scope: Label normalization cuts a run label longer than 24 characters at the last word boundary within that limit.
